description: Zawrot Glowy, the spirit of vertigo: a whirling vortex like a small tornado of violet and grey wind, spinning leaves and bark chips, not a person, no woman, one huge hypnotic spiral eye in the middle of the whirl, two whirling arms of wind reaching out, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, floating, full body, the creature alone, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
